doubts: A page for several access routes and track sections, recorded as a network. Each section is given as A to B and recorded as one way; the page does not say whether people return the same way. The Hunter Valley Track's end ref T10 (The Forks) is assumed to be the forks of the East and West Branches the text names. Scrubby Creek / Scrubby Flat Creek, Kidds Bush Campsite and the Dingle Burn carpark have no entries, so their refs are null. Ferguson Hut is the start of the main way, so it is not listed in huts. The West Branch bushline route (W6) is described only in outline. DOC gives no overall time or distance for the page.
